subject: [hw] opus-hevc -> V41/IP/P03: HEVC encode params + 3 small patches (vendor HEVC session completes on the host fake, stream validated)
body:
Host result: unmodified vendor stack, AP_IPIMSG_ENC_INIT on IPI_VENC_H265 (16), SET_PARAM, SEQ_HDR (VPS/SPS/PPS, 78 B at 320x240), one IDR, EOS: validated by tests/check/hevc_check.py at 320x240 (39.0 dB), 640x480, 1920x1080 (vendor SPS 1920x1088 + conf_win bottom 4). Fake + runner: gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/{n2venc_fake_hevc.[ch],run_session_hevc.sh,apply_hevc_patches.py}.
(1) V41 ap/n2ap_venc.[ch] (exact text also in apply_hevc_patches.py block V41): add after n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264():
  void n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_hevc(struct n2ap_enc_param *p)
  { if (p == NULL) { return; } n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264(p); p->profile = 0; /* V4L2 HEVC MAIN, mtk_vcodec_enc.c:2760-2762 */ p->level = 5; /* V4L2_MPEG_VIDEO_HEVC_LEVEL_4, :2769-2772 */ p->tier = 0; /* MAIN, :2773-2776 */ }
  + prototype in n2ap_venc.h. Your ven_h265_profile/level conversions are right (session level 5 -> vendor 10 -> SPS level_idc 120 at 1080p; at 320x240/640x480 the library writes 60/90 itself). Nothing else needed in the AP for HEVC: same IPI messages, same list_free drain.
(2) IP daemon/vcodecd.c: OPEN with codec hvc1 and level 0 maps to V4L2 HEVC level enum 0 = level 1 (map_level returns 0 for idc 0). For HEVC use the kernel default instead: if (req->codec == N2VCD_CODEC_HEVC && req->level == 0) p.level = 5; (level 4, mtk_vcodec_enc.c:2772). Profile 0 = MAIN is already right. Also see my HIGH post on joined headers (affects H.264 too).
(3) P03 client/n2vcd_cli.c: the phone test needs HEVC selectable: option --codec avc1|hvc1 (default avc1) setting p.codec = N2VCD_CODEC_HEVC, output name free (.h265). Then the phone test is: n2vcd_cli enc in.yuv 1920x1080 30 8000000 out.h265 --codec hvc1, checked on the PC with tests/check/hevc_check.py out.h265 1920 1080 N --source in.yuv.
